tt:npc/thornwatch_outpost.title: Thornwatch Outpost
tt:npc/thornwatch_outpost.locked: Thornwatch sentries bar the gate. "Captain's orders. Nobody in until Emberhold has a charter."

tt:npc/pell_ruin.title: Ruin with a Tent
tt:npc/pell_ruin.locked: Something in the ruin ticks, then a voice: "Not yet! Not yet. Grow your village first, then we'll talk."

tt:npc/tamsin_grove.title: The Old Oak
tt:npc/tamsin_grove.locked: The roots tighten. The wood isn't ready to speak with you yet.

tt:npc/conclave_tower.title: Lumen Conclave Tower
tt:npc/conclave_tower.locked: A ward of bent light turns you around. The Conclave only opens to someone it has heard of.

tt:npc/stranger_caravan.title: A Clean Caravan
tt:npc/stranger_caravan.locked: A polite voice from the wagon: "Closed, I'm afraid. Come back when Emberhold is a town."

tt:npc/wren_lookout.title: Scout's Lookout
tt:npc/wren_lookout.locked: The camp is empty and the snow untouched. Whoever lives here is out scouting.

tt:npc/sol_archive.title: Sunken Archive
tt:npc/sol_archive.locked: The archive door is sealed with old Accord wax. It will open when the realms do.
